name: feedback
description: Report malong tool issues/errors/ideas; collected locally.

action.description: record (default) submits feedback; list reads aggregated feedback (new + legacy state paths)

tool.description: Tool name that triggered the feedback (required when recording)

issue.description: What went wrong or could be improved (required when recording)

limit.description: For action=list: max recent entries to return (1-500, default 50)
